zh: 分组密码：把固定长度的数据块映射为同长度密文块的密码。
Feistel 网络：把块分成两半，每轮用轮函数更新一半、再与另一半异或的结构。
轮函数：每轮中由右半块和子密钥计算、再与左半块异或的函数。
子密钥：由主密钥经密钥调度得到的每轮 48 位密钥。
S 盒：把 6 位输入映射为 4 位输出的非线性替代表。
初始置换：DES 在轮运算前对 64 位块执行的固定位置重排。
密钥调度：从 64 位主密钥生成 16 个 48 位子密钥的算法。
弱密钥：使所有子密钥相同、从而 E(E(P))=P 的密钥。
互补性：若 E_K(P)=C，则 E 的按位取反密钥与明文得到 C 的按位取反。
生日碰撞：块空间有限时，随机块重复概率随块数平方增长的现象。
en: Block cipher: a cipher that maps fixed-length data blocks to ciphertext blocks of the same length.
Feistel network: a structure that splits the block into halves and updates one half with a round function before XORing it with the other.
Round function: the per-round function computed from the right half and a subkey, then XORed with the left half.
Subkey: the 48-bit per-round key produced by the key schedule from the master key.
S-box: a nonlinear substitution table mapping six input bits to four output bits.
Initial permutation: the fixed positional rearrangement DES applies to the 64-bit block before the rounds.
Key schedule: the algorithm that derives sixteen 48-bit subkeys from the 64-bit master key.
Weak key: a key that makes all subkeys identical, so that E(E(P))=P.
Complementation property: if E_K(P)=C, then the bitwise-complemented key and plaintext produce the bitwise complement of C.
Birthday collision: the rapid growth of repeat probability when random blocks are drawn from a finite block space.
